name: Daystruct API
description: Read-only access to pre-refined, provenance-backed evidence, plus authenticated management of developer-owned agent identities. Registered capabilities are declarations only: registered agents are not routable and this API has no task-dispatch surface. Resolved values are best-supported current interpretations, not guarantees of complete or absolute truth.
